parse_re2_benchlog: parse an re2 benchlog file and extract benchmark data into a dictionary grouped by test name
generate_plot_from_benchlog: run the CLI tool to generate a PNG plot from an re2 benchlog file using gnuplot
gen_csv_tempfiles: generate temporary CSV files from parsed benchlog data for use with gnuplot plotting
run_gnuplot_script: execute the gnuplot command with a generated script to produce a benchmark performance plot
use_gnuplot_context_manager: use the gnuplot class as a context manager to auto-cleanup temporary CSV files after plotting
